subject: cs-9
description: Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), Natural Language Processing (NLP), Computer Vision, Robotics, IoT, and Cloud Computing.

questions.question: Artificial Intelligence is a branch of computer science that focuses on:

options.B: Making machines perform human-like tasks intelligently

questions.explanation: AI aims to create machines capable of intelligent behavior — simulating human reasoning, learning, and decision-making capabilities.

questions.question: In supervised machine learning, the training data is:

options.B: Labeled with known inputs and correct output responses

questions.explanation: Supervised learning trains a model using labeled examples — input-output pairs — so the model learns to map inputs to correct outputs.

questions.question: Unsupervised machine learning uses which technique to group similar data?

options.B: Regression

questions.explanation: Unsupervised learning finds hidden patterns in unlabeled data through clustering — grouping data points with similar characteristics together.

questions.question: ChatGPT was developed by:

options.B: Microsoft

questions.explanation: ChatGPT (Chat Generative Pre-trained Transformer) was developed by OpenAI, an American AI research laboratory.

questions.question: Which of the following is a genuine ethical concern with ChatGPT?

options.B: It requires a paid subscription
options.C: It can enable plagiarism and spread misinformation

questions.explanation: ChatGPT raises ethical concerns including academic dishonesty (plagiarism), potential misinformation, data privacy issues, and bias.

questions.question: Grammarly is an AI tool primarily used for:

options.B: Correcting spelling and grammar in documents

questions.explanation: Grammarly automatically checks and suggests corrections for grammar, spelling, and writing style. However, it is not 100% accurate.

questions.question: Which is a DISADVANTAGE of AI algorithms?

options.B: They help diagnose diseases early
options.C: They can introduce bias leading to discriminatory outcomes
options.D: They suggest shortest routes for drivers

questions.explanation: AI algorithms trained on biased data can produce discriminatory results — affecting hiring, lending, healthcare and legal decisions unfairly.

questions.question: What does the machine learning process begin with?

options.B: Learning process

questions.explanation: The ML process starts with collecting training data, followed by creating the algorithm, learning, building the model, and predicting results.

questions.question: Lovo AI is best described as a:

options.B: Text-to-speech AI tool

questions.explanation: Lovo AI is an award-winning text-to-speech tool that uses AI to generate realistic voices in 100+ languages for various audio/video content.

questions.question: Which AI application converts spoken words to text?

options.B: NLP Chatbot

questions.explanation: Speech recognition converts spoken language into text. It is used by virtual assistants (Siri, Alexa) and accessibility tools. ★ Additional Questions — Topics 5.1 to 5.1.4

questions.question: Machine learning algorithms improve their capabilities over time because:

options.A: They are reprogrammed daily by developers
options.B: They improve as more sample data is input into the computers
options.D: They connect to the internet automatically

questions.explanation: Machine learning algorithms improve their capabilities over time as more sample data is input in the computers..

questions.question: In supervised machine learning, the car price prediction example uses which type of data as INPUT?

options.B: Engine type, transmission, seats, safety features, etc.
options.C: The country where the car will be sold
options.D: The name of the car manufacturer only

questions.explanation: engine type, transmission, seats, drive type, keyless entry, push start, safety features, and country of manufacturing as inputs for car price prediction.

questions.question: In unsupervised machine learning, the loan risk example eliminates age, mobile number, and gender because:

options.A: They are too difficult to collect
options.B: They are not important for determining loan risk
options.D: They are already stored in the bank's database

questions.explanation: 'information about age, mobile number and gender are not important for determining the loan risk, therefore they can be eliminated'..

questions.question: The machine learning process has how many stages ?
questions.explanation: 5 stages: (a) Collection of training data, (b) Creating algorithm, (c) Learning process, (d) Creating training model, (e) Predicting results.

questions.question: Why is it difficult to find errors in AI algorithms ?

options.A: Because AI algorithms run too fast
options.B: Because there is no proper breakdown of how the AI algorithm makes decisions
options.C: Because AI systems are kept secret
options.D: Because only AI engineers can access the code

questions.explanation: It is difficult to find out what went wrong in AI algorithms as there is no proper breakdown on how the AI algorithm is making decisions..

questions.question: Which of the following is listed as a BENEFIT of using AI systems in ?

options.A: AI systems can replace all human workers
options.B: AI systems in hospitals provide better diagnosis and treatment of diseases at early stage
options.C: AI eliminates the need for education

questions.explanation: hospital diagnosis (e.g. cancer) as an important benefit of AI — providing better diagnosis and treatment at an early stage.

questions.question: ChatGPT stands for:

options.B: Chat Generative Pre-trained Transformer

questions.explanation: ChatGPT stands for Chat Generative Pre-trained Transformer developed by OpenAI..

questions.question: Lovo AI supports how many languages for text-to-speech generation?

options.B: More than 50

questions.explanation: Lovo AI 'supports 500 high quality voices and more than 100 languages' for creating audio and video content.

questions.question: Which of the following is an ethical issue related to AI tools that create audio, video, music, and images?

options.B: Copyright infringement and harmful content

questions.explanation: AI tools that create new contents such as audio, video, music, text and images can raise the issue of copyright infringements and harmful contents..

questions.question: Virtual assistants like Apple Siri and Amazon Alexa are described as:

options.B: Expert systems for medical diagnosis
options.C: Interactive AI-based application programs that understand natural language

questions.explanation: a virtual assistant as 'an interactive AI based application program that can understand natural language'.

questions.question: Which of the following is a task that virtual assistants can perform, ?

options.B: Sending text messages, making phone calls, playing music, and making purchases

questions.explanation: sending text messages, making phone calls, playing music, making purchases, making search queries, and creating emails. as tasks virtual assistants perform.

questions.question: AI-based automation, can cause:

options.A: Increase in all types of jobs
options.B: Better work-life balance for all workers
options.C: Job losses in areas such as manufacturing, education, and healthcare

questions.explanation: 'AI-based automation can lead to job losses in many areas such as automobile manufacturing, business, education, healthcare, agriculture' as a harm of AI.

questions.question: A driverless self-driving car having an accident is given in as an example of:

options.A: A benefit of AI in transportation
options.B: How AI can cause harm or death

questions.explanation: the self-driving car accident as an example under harms of AI algorithms: 'Driverless self-driving car can have an accident. This shows how AI algorithms can cause death'.

questions.question: what must designers of AI algorithms focus on?

options.A: Making AI as fast as possible
options.B: Instilling moral and ethical values in AI systems and focusing on benefiting people
options.C: Ensuring AI systems replace human workers efficiently
options.D: Making AI algorithms secret and transparent only to experts

questions.explanation: Designers of AI algorithm must instill moral and ethical values in AI systems and focus on benefiting people..

questions.question: Which of the following popular virtual assistants is mentioned in ?

options.B: Apple Siri, Amazon Alexa, Google Assistant, ChatGPT, and Microsoft Cortana

questions.explanation: Apple.s Siri, Amazon Alexa, Google Assistant, ChatGPT and Microsoft Cortana' as popular virtual assistants. Topic 5.2 to 5.2.5 — AI Applications: Speech Recognition, Computer Vision, NLP & Expert Systems

questions.question: Computer Vision gives computers the ability to:

options.B: Extract meaningful information from digital images and videos

questions.explanation: Computer Vision uses cameras, data, and algorithms to enable computers to interpret visual information from the real world.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT an application of NLP?

options.B: Sentiment analysis

questions.explanation: Traffic flow monitoring uses Computer Vision. NLP applications include translation, sentiment analysis, chatbots, and spam detection.

questions.question: An Expert System is different from regular software because it:

options.B: Has decision-making ability like a human expert in a specific domain
options.D: Can only be used in hospitals

questions.explanation: Expert systems use a knowledge base and reasoning rules to make decisions like a domain expert — they go beyond standard programmed logic.

questions.question: In an expert system, the 'knowledge database' is created by:

options.A: The end user of the system
options.B: Feeding knowledge from many domain experts into the system

questions.explanation: The knowledge database is built by systematically collecting knowledge from multiple domain experts and encoding it into the system.

questions.question: Cloud computing delivers computing services through:

options.B: Personal USB devices

questions.explanation: Cloud computing delivers services (servers, storage, databases, software) over the Internet, allowing access from anywhere with connectivity.

questions.question: Which cloud model gives a single organization FULL control over its resources?

options.B: Hybrid Cloud

questions.explanation: A Private Cloud is dedicated to a single organization, giving it full control over infrastructure, data, and security settings.

questions.question: A company that uses both on-premises servers and cloud services together is using:

options.B: Private Cloud

questions.explanation: Hybrid Cloud combines public and private cloud environments, sharing data and applications between them for maximum flexibility.

questions.question: Which type of cloud is most suitable for a startup that wants low initial costs and scalability?

options.B: Hybrid Cloud

questions.explanation: Public Cloud resources are owned by cloud providers and offered over the internet — ideal for startups needing scalability without high capital investment.

questions.question: Which AI application can automatically adjust traffic signals based on vehicle count?

options.B: Expert System

questions.explanation: Computer Vision can analyze camera feeds at intersections to count vehicles and automatically adjust traffic signal timing accordingly.

questions.question: Virtual assistants like Siri and Alexa primarily use which AI technology?

options.B: Expert Systems only

questions.explanation: Virtual assistants use Speech Recognition to understand voice input and NLP to process and respond to natural language commands. ★ Additional Questions — Topics 5.2 to 5.2.5

questions.question: Speech recognition is particularly helpful for people who:

options.B: Have physical disabilities that make typing on a keyboard difficult

questions.explanation: speech recognition 'is also very helpful for people who have physical disabilities in typing on the keyboard'.

questions.question: A disadvantage of speech recognition mentioned in is:

options.B: People have different pronunciations making it difficult for the system to understand all words
options.C: It can only recognize one language
options.D: It requires an internet connection at all times

questions.explanation: People have different pronunciation and this may make it difficult for the speech recognition system to understand all the words..

questions.question: Computer Vision repeatedly performs data analysis on images/videos until it:

options.B: Recognizes and distinguishes images to carry out automated actions

questions.explanation: Computer vision applications repeatedly perform data analysis until it recognizes and distinguishes images. After deep understanding, it carries out automated actions..

questions.question: Which of the following is a Computer Vision application listed in ?

options.B: Language translation

questions.explanation: computer vision applications including healthcare, security, facial recognition, self-driving cars, parking detection, traffic flow analysis, and manufacturing.

questions.question: The purpose of NLP is to:

options.B: Provide easy communication between computers and humans using natural language
options.C: Increase the speed of computer processors

questions.explanation: The purpose of NLP is to provide easy communication between computers and humans by using natural language..

questions.question: Which of the following is listed as an NLP application in ?

options.B: Parking detection

questions.explanation: bias and fake news detection under NLP applications alongside language translation, spam detection, chatbots, sentiment analysis, and spell-check.

questions.question: Expert systems use which two things to find solutions to domain-specific problems?

options.B: Knowledge and reasoning

questions.explanation: expert systems as using 'knowledge and reasoning to find solutions of problems related to a specific area'.

questions.question: Which of the following is a listed application of Expert Systems in ?

options.B: Social media feed management
options.C: Loan analysis and fraud detection in finance

questions.explanation: expert system applications including: hospital diagnosis, loan analysis, fraud detection, cybersecurity, product design, project scheduling, and plant monitoring.

questions.question: When a user makes a query in an expert system, the system responds by:

options.A: Searching the internet for the answer
options.B: Asking the user to fill a questionnaire to enter required information

questions.explanation: When an end user makes a query, the expert system asks the user to enter required information about it by filling a questionnaire..

questions.question: NLP is described in as a difficult task because:

options.B: Very complex algorithms are needed to analyze, understand, and translate natural language
options.D: It requires special hardware to function

questions.explanation: NLP is a difficult task to achieve. Very complex algorithms are used to analyze, understand and translate the natural language in both spoken and written forms..

questions.question: Computer Vision gives a computer the ability to 'see' in the same way AI gives it the ability to:

options.B: Store data

questions.explanation: AI computer vision gives ability to computer to see just like it gives ability to think. — drawing a direct parallel between vision and intelligence.

questions.question: Which of the following is listed in as an area where AI is applied?

options.B: Fashion design only

questions.explanation: AI application areas including healthcare, education, transportation, research, biometrics, advertising, helping wildlife, cybersecurity, agriculture, business, and defense.

questions.question: In the development of an expert system, the first step is to:

options.A: Ask the user to fill a questionnaire
options.B: Build a machine learning model
options.C: Collect sufficient knowledge from many domain experts and create a knowledge database
options.D: Connect the system to the cloud

questions.explanation: the first step is: 'Sufficient amount of knowledge about a specific area is obtained from many experts and fed in the expert system. A knowledge database is created'.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT listed as an NLP application in ?

options.B: Personal assistants like Siri

questions.explanation: Parking detection is a Computer Vision application. 's NLP list includes: translation, spam detection, voice recognition, web search, chatbots, personal assistants, spell-check, and sentiment analysis.

questions.question: AI algorithms used in healthcare can be harmful if inaccurate because:

options.A: They slow down the hospital's computer systems
options.B: They can recommend wrong medicines which can be harmful or even cause death
options.D: They are too expensive to maintain

questions.explanation: the AI system can recommend a wrong medicine for a patient which can be very harmful and can even cause death. as a harm of AI in healthcare. Topic 5.4 — Cloud Computing: Public, Private & Hybrid Cloud ★ Newly Added

questions.question: Cloud Computing refers to:

options.A: Storing files only on local hard drives
options.B: Delivery of computing services over the Internet by cloud computing vendors
options.C: A type of physical server installed in offices

questions.explanation: cloud computing as 'delivery of computing services over the Internet by cloud computing vendors' including servers, storage, databases, networking, and software.

questions.question: In cloud computing, 'the Internet becomes the cloud' means:

options.A: Data is stored inside internet cables
options.B: Users can access and process data with any internet-connected device from anywhere in the world
options.C: The internet controls all computer hardware
options.D: Cloud services only work through Wi-Fi

questions.explanation: The Internet becomes the cloud and users can access and process the data with any device that can connect to the Internet anywhere in the world..

questions.question: In a Public Cloud, resources are owned and operated by:

options.B: A cloud service provider, managed and maintained by them
options.D: A group of private companies jointly

questions.explanation: In public cloud, resources are owned and operated by a cloud service provider instead of being installed in-house. Resources are managed and maintained by the cloud service provider..

questions.question: Which cloud model is described as being dedicated to a SINGLE organization?

options.B: Hybrid Cloud

questions.explanation: In private cloud, cloud computing is dedicated to a single organization. The user organization is responsible for the operation and maintenance of infrastructure..

questions.question: Private Cloud gives an organization more control over:

options.B: Servers and computer network

questions.explanation: Private cloud solution provides more control over servers and computer network. — making it suitable for organizations requiring high security and control.

questions.question: Hybrid Cloud is described in as:

options.A: A cloud model used only by government organizations
options.B: A combination of public and private cloud that allows data and applications to be shared between them
options.C: A cloud service that only stores images and videos
options.D: A model where multiple public clouds are combined

questions.explanation: Hybrid Cloud as 'a combination of public and private cloud. This cloud computing model uses technology that allows data and applications to be shared between them'.

questions.question: Public Cloud provides high speed connectivity to ensure:

options.B: Rapid access to applications and data

questions.explanation: Public cloud provides high speed connectivity to ensure rapid access to application and data..

questions.question: Cloud computing is described as an alternative to:

options.B: In-house data processing

questions.explanation: Cloud computing enables businesses and organizations to access databases and cloud applications over the Internet from remote physical servers. It is an alternative to in-house data processing..

questions.question: In a Private Cloud, the user organization is responsible for:

options.B: Operation and maintenance of infrastructure including hardware, software, and network
options.D: Providing cloud services to other companies

questions.explanation: The user organization is responsible for the operation and maintenance of infrastructure (hardware, software, network, etc.)..

questions.question: Which of the following services is listed in as part of cloud computing?

options.B: Servers, storage, databases, networking, and software

questions.explanation: cloud computing services as: 'servers, storage, databases, networking, software etc.' — delivered over the internet by cloud vendors.

questions.question: Which cloud type would BEST suit an organization that needs both security/control and scalability?

options.B: Private Cloud only

questions.explanation: Hybrid Cloud combines private cloud (for control and security) with public cloud (for scalability and cost-efficiency), making it ideal when both are needed.

questions.question: Cloud computing in is described as beneficial to:

options.B: Businesses and organizations of all sizes that need to access databases and cloud applications

questions.explanation: cloud computing 'enables businesses and organizations to access databases and cloud applications over the Internet from remote physical servers'.

questions.question: A key advantage of Public Cloud over Private Cloud is that it does NOT require:

options.B: In-house installation and management of resources

questions.explanation: public cloud resources are 'owned and operated by a cloud service provider instead of being installed in-house on local devices'.

questions.question: The three cloud computing models described in are:

options.B: Public, Private, and Hybrid Cloud

questions.explanation: exactly three cloud models: Public Cloud, Private Cloud, and Hybrid Cloud — each with different ownership, control, and access characteristics.

questions.question: Hackers developing powerful AI algorithms to bypass cybersecurity is listed as:

options.B: A cloud computing risk
options.C: A harm or disadvantage of AI algorithms

questions.explanation: Hackers can develop powerful AI algorithms to bypass cybersecurity and cause malicious cyberattacks. under the harms/disadvantages of AI algorithms.
